title: metadata-protocol: beside one enabled holder of a doc, the bare /meta doc doors serve the holder's doc while the registry and MetadataFacade.get serve the environment's stamp-less entry
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5obaLbqgzRUR9xXfft

Filing gate: ① violation of a declared contract (class b), measured. Follow-up named by review record 6921035514 (N2) for the deviation PR #34347 declares under "Not moved" (review S1): the one-holder cell was pinned, not moved.

Seam: spec:ruling 6893582352 (the environment's own entry answers first) → runtime:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts#refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead` and `readMetaItem` step 2 (the bare doc read's code step) | consumer: the `/meta/doc/NAME`, `/layers` and `/published` doors of the dispatcher and RestServer.

## Symptom

One enabled package A ships doc `N`, and a stamp-less runtime registration of `N` (no `_packageId`, no `_provenance`) sits in the registry's bare slot. `registry.resolveItem('doc', 'N')` and `MetadataFacade.get` answer the environment's entry. The protocol's bare plain read, `/layers` (as `code` and `effective`) and both `/published` doors answer A's doc. Two readers of one name in one environment give two different items.

Beside two or more enabled holders, #34347 makes every bare door serve the entry (ruling 6893582352). Beside one holder, the doors keep the holder: `refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead` returns the registry's package-less answer only when `packageScopedHoldersOf('doc', N)` names two or more packages, so with one holder no entry is returned, and the metadata service's copy (A's) answers step 2.

## Location

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`: `refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead` (the `>= 2` holder count), `bareDocServiceCopyDisplacesEntry`, and `readMetaItem` step 2.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`: the layered read's bare doc code layer (`bareDocEnvironmentEntry` is set only beside two holders).
- `/published`: `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` and `packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts` (their bare doc swap follows the layered read).

## How it was found

Measured on the composed artifact rig (`MetadataPlugin` artifact door plus `AppPlugin`), dispatcher and RestServer, both registration orders, during #34347. It is pinned there as `[measured, unresolved] one holder beside a stamp-less bare entry` in `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts`, and declared in `.changeset/34247-exact-read-own-item-or-none.md` under "Not moved". A hydrated package-less row (`_provenance: 'org'`) beside one holder reads the same way on the bare doors, with the row as `/layers` `overlay`.

reach: `GET /api/v1/meta/doc/:name` (and `/layers`, `/published`) on a deployment where one installed package ships the name and a runtime registration of it carries no package. Measured.

## Acceptance

1. Decide first, and record the decision: whether ruling 6893582352 (the environment's own entry answers first) holds beside ONE enabled holder, as it does beside two. The ruling was argued beside two holders, and card #34248's acceptance names two or more, so the one-holder cell needs its own ruling before code changes.
2. If it holds: beside one enabled holder and a stamp-less bare entry, the bare plain read, `/layers` (entry as `code` and `effective`) and both `/published` doors serve the entry on both transports, in both registration orders. The holder's own address `?package=A` still reads A's doc.
3. If it does not: the registry and `MetadataFacade.get` answer the holder in that state, so every reader agrees. The decision says which reader moves.
4. CONTROLs: one holder with no bare entry (the holder's doc, unchanged); two holders plus an entry (the entry, as #34347 pins); a hydrated `_provenance: 'org'` row beside one holder.
5. Declaration: the bare doors' FROM→TO for the moved reader, with `Clause-②:` as measured.

## Related

PR #34347 (#34247, #34248); ruling 6893582352; review records 6916685896 and 6921035514; #34041 (one enabled holder beside a disabled one); ADR-0150 D3.

Dedupe: searched open issues on 2026-11-16 for `"stamp-less" doc holder` (3 hits), `refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead` (1 hit) and `"one holder" bare doc entry` (19 hits); none reports the one-holder cell (closest: #34248, two or more holders; #34417, the exact address after hydration).
